chunks: Khalid ibn Najih narrated from him that he said:
"The adhan and the iqamah are to be recited firmly."
And in another report: "[They are] paused."

key_terms.الْإِقَامَةُ: the call establishing the commencement of salat (prayer)
key_terms.مَوْقُوفَانِ: delivered with pauses or stopping between phrases

ai.seo_question: How should the adhan and iqamah be recited according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a ruling on how the adhan and iqamah are to be delivered. It indicates that both are to be recited in a measured, firm manner, and another report describes them as being uttered with pauses.
